purpose: Retrospective geographically grouped audit of low-label clear-cut classification; no first-of-kind architecture or untouched external validation claim
development_history: Architectures and recipes were developed on this dataset in prior v2/v3 work. New folds prevent direct fit/evaluation overlap but cannot erase dataset-level adaptive development. v3's repeatedly examined 486-point test is secondary, not primary paper evidence.
data: Unchanged 2213 high-confidence DISFOR series, one 24-month window per location, 1937 intact / 276 clear-cut; components within 5 km or shared source event remain indivisible
partition: 5-fold StratifiedGroupKFold shuffle random_state=4192026 over all 2213 points; three training seeds 7,17,27; no fold or seed selected by outcomes
training: All neural methods fixed 40 supervised epochs; weighted CE and 10% month removal as v3. SSL has 60 pretraining epochs on outer-training observations only. No early stopping, validation labels, calibration or threshold fitting; threshold 0.5 for all methods.
ablations_at_20_percent: iid_ssl with observed-cell masking probability 1/3 matching expected block-plus-band coverage
step_matched_supervised with ceil((60*ceil(n_train/64)+40*ceil(n_labeled/64))/ceil(n_labeled/64)) epochs, matching optimizer-step budget within one epoch
metadata_only_random_forest using longitude latitude target year and source campaign index
initialization_and_subsets: Paired model seeds, identical nested per-class labeled subsets; no outer-test normalization or pretraining; metadata and mask controls use the same labeled points
primary_endpoint: Pooled out-of-fold macro-F1 difference SSL minus supervised at 20% labels, averaged over three seeds; paired spatial-component bootstrap 2000 draws with three seeds kept together and class support checked
secondary_endpoints: PR-AUC, ROC-AUC, class recall, Brier, full-label results, masking and compute controls. Secondary paired bootstrap intervals are exploratory, not multiplicity-adjusted significance tests.
generalization_probe: Attempt unused high-confidence 2017/2024 windows and exclude every previously used point, points within 5 km of used points, and shared event identifiers. Document support before scoring. If inadequate, report insufficiency rather than claiming external validation.
reporting: Report all 180 fits: 120 primary and 60 controls. Negative findings and sampling-confound diagnostics retained. No outcome-driven retraining or main-claim changes concealed.
reproducibility: Freeze protocol/code/data hashes, each fold's IDs and groups, class counts, per-fit training records, predictions, environment and timing
